title: Forward-observation reliability analysis
hypothesis: Recorded forward-observation FAIL cycles through 2026-09-17 can be classified from frozen evidence without implying an execution-safety breach.
result: PASS: 10 raw FAIL cycles classified as 9 contained upstream/provider failures and 1 contained local concurrency/state-race failure; 0 unclassified failures, 0 recorded safety violations, and 0 M006e.2 hash-failure sessions. Coverage was 339/387 cycles (87.60%), with 48 unobserved cycles remaining a separate availability concern.
